title: Session settings: secret files denied, Bash sandboxed
summary: A .claude/settings.json seed that denies reading .env files and secrets/ and turns on Claude Code's Bash sandbox without dropping a prompt, with a guard against the settings that widen what every session may do.
postInstall: Read .claude/settings.json before committing it: it applies to every session opened in the repository. Add a Read(…) deny rule for each place your project keeps secrets (key files, credential directories, local databases).

The Bash sandbox needs bubblewrap and socat on Linux and WSL2 (nothing on macOS; native Windows has none). Where they are missing, Claude Code runs commands unsandboxed and only says so at startup: docs/conventions/session-settings.md § Sandbox.
This file has never been run live by the kit's authors (docs/conventions/session-settings.md § Status): check it once in a session (§ Live check).
Restart open Claude Code sessions so they load the new settings.
